questions.q: Why does SQL Pete's pipeline run SFT before RLHF?
options: RLHF cannot be run on language models
SFT gives the policy a reasonable starting point to sample from, so the reward signal has something good to reinforce
SFT is required by the transformers library
RLHF only works on models that have never been fine-tuned
questions.explain: A base model with no task-specific training mostly produces off-task text, giving RLHF's reward signal nothing good to reinforce.

questions.q: What does the SFT training data for SQL Pete consist of?
options: Roughly 2,000 (question, gold SQL) pairs scoped to Northwind and AdventureWorks2012
Millions of scraped SQL queries from the internet
Only questions, with no SQL labels
A single schema with no example queries
questions.explain: The SFT dataset is roughly 2,000 curated, hand-verified (question, SQL) pairs scoped to the two target schemas.

questions.q: What does LoRA do differently from full fine-tuning?
options: It deletes most of the base model's layers
It freezes the base model and trains small low-rank adapter matrices injected into select layers
It trains every parameter in the model simultaneously
It replaces the tokenizer with a smaller vocabulary
questions.explain: LoRA freezes the base model's weights and trains only small low-rank adapter matrices, usually on attention projections, which is far cheaper than full fine-tuning.

questions.q: In the LoraConfig used for SQL Pete, what does `target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"]` specify?
options: The database tables the model is allowed to query
The specific attention projection matrices that receive LoRA adapters
The names of the training data files
The reward function's output format
questions.explain: target_modules names which weight matrices — here the query and value projections in attention blocks — get LoRA adapters attached.

questions.q: What is the output of the SFT stage, and what happens to it next?
options: A finished product with no further training needed
A checkpoint with a trained LoRA adapter, which Lesson 18's RLHF policy is initialized from
A dataset of new question/SQL pairs
A reward model ready to score outputs
questions.explain: SFT produces a checkpoint — SQL Pete plus a trained LoRA adapter — that the RLHF stage in Lesson 18 initializes its policy from.
